description.value: A BC Parks frontcountry campground on the shores of Alleyne and Kentucky Lakes in cattle-country grasslands near Merritt, offering good fishing and wildlife watching; note that Alleyne Lake's deep mud makes swimming impractical and children risk getting stuck near the water's edge.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is the official BC Parks page for Kentucky-Alleyne Park, confirming this is an active provincial park campground in the Thompson region. Potable water is explicitly confirmed: 'Water standpipes are available throughout the campground.' Reservations are confirmed via the prominent 'Book camping' feature and the frontcountry camping subpage noting reservations available at over 110 BC Parks campgrounds. No evidence exists for most optional amenities (showers, laundry, device charging, etc.), and the OSM tag internet_access=no aligns with the website's note that 'most parks lack internet connectivity.'
concerns: OSM name 'Alleyne Lake Campground' differs from the BC Parks official park name 'Kentucky-Alleyne Park'; the OSM name appears to refer to one specific campground within the park.

The OSM phone (+1-250-320-9305) and email (parkinquiries@telus.net) belong to the park operator Brandywine Environmental Management Ltd., not BC Parks central; the website does not list this number, so phone contact_confirmed is set to null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is an active BC Parks campground with confirmed potable water and an online reservation system, making it a legitimate and useful overnight stop for touring cyclists in the Thompson/Okanagan region.

wow_evidence: Water standpipes are available throughout the campground
